contribution.title: Public contributions
contribution.empty: No public tasks yet. Refresh after a maintainer publishes one.
contribution.select: Select a public task to read its goal and start contributing.
contribution.setup: No clone needed: choose a save folder and Pero clones the repository and creates a task branch. Install and sign in to a coding CLI before starting. GitHub CLI (gh) is only needed when publishing a PR.
contribution.agent_running: Agent is working. Return to the coding session to view progress or stop it.
contribution.gh_missing: To publish a PR, install GitHub CLI (gh), then run gh auth login --hostname github.com --git-protocol https in any terminal folder. You do not need to clone the repository. Return here and check changes again.
contribution.gh_auth: Run gh auth login --hostname github.com --git-protocol https in any terminal folder, then check changes again. Pero GitHub sign-in is for task identity; gh authorizes fork, push and PR creation.
contribution.publish_help: This action commits the reviewed changes, pushes the contribution branch and creates a draft PR. The task remains pending review.
contribution.publish: Commit, push and create draft PR
contribution.pr_saved: PR linked to this task. Awaiting maintainer review.
contribution.pr_pending: PR created. Its link has not been saved to the task yet.
